tab_editor.title: Tab Editor
tab_editor.grid_title: Grid resolution: {{short}} ({{name}}) — re-grids every measure and replaces the current rhythm
tab_editor.auto_next_hint: Type a fret and the cursor jumps to the next beat on the same string, so you can enter a run without arrowing across. It wraps into the following measure and stops at the end of the tab.
tab_editor.auto_next_hint2: Turn it off to type frets above 9: two-digit frets need both digits in the same cell (1 then 2 → 12), and auto-advance moves the cursor after the first one.
tab_editor.import_gp_hint: Drop a GP3/GP4/GP5/GPX/GP file, then pick a track to load it into the editor.
tab_editor.incomplete_one: {{count}} measure doesn't fill its time signature
tab_editor.incomplete: {{count}} measures don't fill their time signature
tab_editor.fix_all_hint: Pad every short bar with rests until it fills its time signature — the notes stay where they are

tab_editor.beat_title: {{name}} — click to select the whole beat, shift-click to extend

tab_editor.selection_summary: {{beats}} beats · {{notes}} notes — every edit below applies to all of them

tab_editor.transpose_up: Transpose the selection up a fret
tab_editor.duration_title: {{name}} ({{short}}) — a longer note takes over the beats after it, a shorter one leaves a rest
tab_editor.dotted_title: Dotted note — half again as long
tab_editor.rest_title: Rest — clears the beat, keeping the timing
tab_editor.rest_title_block: Rest — clears the selected beats, keeping the timing
